proof_body:
by
  intro f g f' g' a L hf hg hg' hinf hq
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨N0, hN0⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hq (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N, N = max N0 (a + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNa : a < N := by
    have h := le_max_right N0 (a + 1)
    rw [← hNdef] at h
    linarith
  have hN0N : N0 ≤ N := hNdef ▸ le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨M1, hM1⟩ := Filter.tendsto_atTop_atTop.1 hinf (2 * (|f N - L * g N| + ε / 2 * |g N|) / ε + 1)
  refine ⟨max (N + 1) M1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hxN : N < x := by
    have h := le_max_left (N + 1) M1
    linarith
  have hgx := hM1 x ((le_max_right _ _).trans hx)
  have hA : 0 ≤ 2 * (|f N - L * g N| + ε / 2 * |g N|) / ε := by positivity
  have hgpos : 0 < g x := by linarith
  have hgA : 2 * (|f N - L * g N| + ε / 2 * |g N|) / ε < g x := by linarith
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hgA
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcq⟩ := exists_ratio_hasDerivAt_eq_ratio_slope f f' hxN
    (fun y hy => (hf y (lt_of_lt_of_le hNa hy.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun y hy => hf y (hNa.trans hy.1)) g g'
    (fun y hy => (hg y (lt_of_lt_of_le hNa hy.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun y hy => hg y (hNa.trans hy.1))
  have hcg : g' c ≠ 0 := hg' c (hNa.trans hc.1)
  have hcl := hN0 c (hN0N.trans hc.1.le)
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hcl
  have hdiff : f x - f N = f' c / g' c * (g x - g N) := by
    field_simp
    linarith
  have e : f x - L * g x = (f N - L * g N) + (f' c / g' c - L) * (g x - g N) := by
    rw [sub_mul]
    linarith
  have b1 : |(f' c / g' c - L) * (g x - g N)| ≤ ε / 2 * (|g x| + |g N|) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hcl.le (abs_sub _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (half_pos hε).le
  have b2 : |f x - L * g x| < ε * g x := by
    rw [e]
    have b3 := abs_add_le (f N - L * g N) ((f' c / g' c - L) * (g x - g N))
    rw [abs_of_pos hgpos] at b1
    nlinarith
  have e2 : f x / g x - L = (f x - L * g x) / g x := by
    field_simp
  rw [Real.dist_eq, e2, abs_div, abs_of_pos hgpos, div_lt_iff₀ hgpos]
  exact b2
target_source: ∀ (f g f' g' : ℝ → ℝ) (a L : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi a, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi a, HasDerivAt g (g' x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi a, g' x ≠ 0) → Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f' x / g' x) Filter.atTop (nhds L) → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) Filter.atTop (nhds L)
